- 2027 Finals is an LA28 Olympic qualifier
- USA 16-player roster confirmed; 7 World Games gold medalists; 2020 Olympians: Valerie Garcia, Dejah Mulipola
- OU players: Alyssa Brito, Jayda Coleman, Tiare Jennings, Kelly Maxwell
- Patty Gasso is head coach of the U.S. WNT
- Same venue (Devon Park, OKC) where USA went 5-0 at 2026 International Cup in gold-medal run
- Wild Card repechage Sept. 16
- Ticket packages on sale per WBSC announcement
**Source confidence:** HIGH — WBSC.org official schedule confirmed; USA Softball press release confirmed

Oklahoma Fall Camp — Wells and Berzon
**Source:** heartland-sports.com, si.com/college/oklahoma, soonersports.com
**Verified Facts (HIGH confidence):**
- Kendall Wells broke the NCAA single-season freshman home run record in 2026; NFCA Freshman of the Year
- Wells fall 2026: 4 HRs in first three fall scrimmages (per SI and Heartland Sports reporting from Aug. 24 forward)
- Wells vs. OCU fall exhibition: 2-for-4, 2 HRs, 3 RBI
- Patty Gasso publicly praised Wells' fall performance (per SI: "How Freshman Kendall Wells Has Impressed Oklahoma's Patty Gasso During Fall Ball")
- Sydney Berzon (2x All-American, LSU): Retired all 6 batters faced in fall exhibition vs. OCU; 2 IP, 3H, 1R, 1BB, 1K in first Battle Series scrimmage (SI confirmed)
- Gasso departure Sept. 12 for Team USA coaching duties (8 days from today)
- Fall schedule: opener Sept. 30 at Love's Field (USAO Oct. 23, Seminole State Oct. 30, East Texas A&M Nov. 4)
- 12 returning players + 9 newcomers
**FLAG on Wells HR total:** Prior pipeline listed 39 HRs for freshman season. Research note: Some sources cited 32 as the record-breaking milestone (NCAArecord); subsequent articles describe tying/surpassing further milestones. Exact final total remains MEDIUM confidence. Articles avoid citing specific number and use "broke the NCAA single-season freshman home run record."
**Source confidence:** HIGH for Wells/Berzon fall camp performance (SI, Heartland Sports); HIGH for fall schedule (SI confirmed)
